children.detail: `doSend()` waits for topic metadata, serializes key and value, chooses a partition (custom `Partitioner` or built-in sticky), then appends to the `RecordAccumulator`. It blocks up to `max.block.ms`.

rows.title: Serialize

rows.title: Partition
rows.detail: Custom `Partitioner` if configured, otherwise built-in sticky partitioner picks based on broker load.

rows.title: Append
rows.detail: Record is appended to the per-partition batch in `RecordAccumulator`. May block if `BufferPool` is full.

children.title: Batching Records
children.sub: Accumulate records into per-partition batches in bounded memory
children.detail: `RecordAccumulator` maintains a `ConcurrentMap` of topic to `TopicInfo`, which holds per-partition `Deque<ProducerBatch>` queues. Batches are backed by `ByteBuffer` from a `BufferPool` bounded by `buffer.memory`.

code.label: Fields: topicInfoMap, batchSize, free BufferPool, muted partitions
append(): try existing batch, allocate buffer, create new batch
BufferPool: bounded memory, FIFO waiters, poolable-size free list

rows.label: batch.size
rows.value: Default 16384 bytes; records accumulate until a batch fills or `linger.ms` expires

rows.label: buffer.memory
rows.value: Default 32 MB total; `send()` blocks when exhausted

rows.label: linger.ms
rows.value: Default 0; artificial delay to allow more records to fill a batch

rows.label: compression.type
rows.value: none, gzip, lz4, snappy, or zstd; applied per batch

rows.label: Allocation strategy
rows.value: Full (one buffer per batch) or incremental/chunked for large batches

issues.title: Chunked allocation rejects compression
issues.detail: When `buffer.memory.allocation.strategy=incremental`, setting any compression type throws `ConfigException`. The two features cannot be used together (tracked as KAFKA-20579).

children.title: Sender Thread
children.sub: Background thread that drains batches and handles responses
children.detail: The `Sender` runs in a daemon thread, calling `runOnce()` in a loop. Each iteration checks transaction state, drains ready batches, groups them into `ProduceRequest` per node, and polls `NetworkClient`.

AUTHORED.title: Storing Records
AUTHORED.sub: Persist records in log segments and tiered storage
AUTHORED.detail: Each topic-partition is an append-only log of segments on disk, managed by `LogManager` and exposed through `UnifiedLog`. Closed segments can be tiered to pluggable remote storage, compacted, or deleted by retention.

children.title: Segments And Indexes
children.sub: Append-only files with sparse offset and time lookups
children.detail: `LocalLog` manages a skip-list of `LogSegment` instances, each backed by a `.log` file and three lazy-loaded index files. Records append to the active segment; when it reaches size or time limits it rolls to a new one.

children.sub: Fetch records by offset with index-assisted lookup
children.detail: `LocalLog.read` finds the floor segment, then calls `LogSegment.read` which uses the offset index to locate the physical position. For `READ_COMMITTED` isolation, aborted transaction ranges are attached from the transaction index.

AUTHORED.title: Reaching Consensus
AUTHORED.sub: Elect leaders and replicate cluster metadata via KRaft
AUTHORED.detail: A Raft-based protocol elects a controller leader, replicates metadata records through a shared log, and materialises them into an immutable MetadataImage that brokers consume via publishers.

code.label: Protocol overview: Kafka-flavoured Raft with PreVote, Fetch-driven replication, and snapshot transfer

children.title: Leader Election
children.sub: Six-state machine elects one leader per epoch
children.detail: `QuorumState` enforces transitions across Unattached, Prospective, Candidate, Leader, Follower, and Resigned states. PreVote prevents disruptive elections by requiring a majority before incrementing the epoch.

code.label: Full state transition diagram documented in Javadoc
transitionToCandidate increments epoch and persists vote
transitionToLeader requires majority vote grant
onBecomeLeader initialises BatchAccumulator and writes epoch control record

children.title: PreVote Phase
children.sub: Non-disruptive election probe before real votes
children.detail: The Prospective state sends PreVote requests without incrementing the epoch. A majority of grants transitions to Candidate; rejection or timeout falls back to Unattached or Follower.

code.label: transitionToProspective: memory-only transition, no epoch bump

children.title: Leading The Epoch
children.sub: Track replication progress and high watermark
children.detail: `LeaderState` tracks each voter's fetch offset to compute the high watermark as the median replicated offset. It sends `BeginQuorumEpoch` to unacknowledged voters and resigns if a `checkQuorumTimer` expires.

issues.title: Leader resigns silently on checkQuorum timeout
issues.detail: If a majority of voters stop fetching within 1.5x the fetch timeout, the leader logs a message and transitions to Unattached, but no error is propagated to the controller layer — pending appends simply fail with NOT_LEADER_OR_FOLLOWER.

children.sub: Central RPC engine driving the Raft protocol

children.sub: Active controller that mutates cluster metadata

children.title: Metadata Image

code.label: run dispatches to list/describe/delete/reset/delete-offsets
collectGroupsOffsets gathers partition assignments and lag

anatomy.caption: Supported actions
rows: Lists groups with optional type and state filtering
Shows offsets, members, or state for named groups
Resets offsets with strategies: to-earliest, to-latest, to-offset, by-duration, etc.
Deletes committed offsets for specific topics
Validates a regex pattern against RE2 format

children.title: Share Group Command
children.sub: Manage share groups and their offsets
children.detail: `ShareGroupCommand` mirrors the consumer group CLI but targets share groups. It uses `Admin.describeShareGroups`, `listShareGroupOffsets`, and `alterShareGroupOffsets`.

code.label: main parses args and dispatches actions
deleteShareGroups validates and deletes groups

children.title: Streams Group Command
children.sub: Manage Kafka Streams groups and internal topics
children.detail: `StreamsGroupCommand` adds topology description and internal topic deletion on top of the standard group actions. Reset-offsets can also delete internal topics with `--delete-all-internal-topics`.

code.label: run dispatches to list/describe/reset/delete/delete-offsets
resetOffsets resets offsets and optionally deletes internal topics
matchesInternalTopicFormat checks Streams naming patterns

children.title: Partition Reassignment
children.sub: Move partition replicas between brokers and log dirs
children.detail: `ReassignPartitionsCommand` reads a JSON reassignment plan, executes it via `Admin.alterPartitionReassignments` and `Admin.alterReplicaLogDirs`, and supports verify, generate, execute, cancel, and list actions.

code.label: main parses args and dispatches to handleAction
verifyAssignment checks partition and log dir move states
executeAssignment submits reassignments with throttling

rows.title: Generate plan
rows.detail: --generate reads topics-to-move JSON and broker list, outputs proposed reassignment JSON.

rows.title: Execute plan
rows.detail: --execute submits the reassignment JSON with optional inter-broker and log-dir throttles.

rows.title: Verify progress
rows.detail: --verify checks partition and log dir move states; clears throttles when done.

rows.title: Cancel or list
rows.detail: --cancel aborts active reassignments; --list shows in-progress moves.

rows.label: ActiveMoveState
rows.note: In progress with future log dir

children.title: Security Tools
children.sub: Manage ACLs and delegation tokens
children.detail: `AclCommand` adds, removes, and lists ACL bindings via `Admin.createAcls`/`describeAcls`/`deleteAcls`. `DelegationTokenCommand` creates, renews, expires, and describes tokens via the Admin API.

code.label: AclCommand dispatches add/remove/list
addAcls checks for duplicates then creates bindings
DelegationTokenCommand dispatches create/renew/expire/describe
createToken calls Admin.createDelegationToken

anatomy.caption: ACL convenience flags for producer and consumer roles
rows: READ, DESCRIBE on topic; READ on group

children.title: Cluster Inspection
children.sub: Query quorum status, features, offsets, and log segments
children.detail: A set of read-only tools for inspecting cluster state: quorum status, feature flags, log directories, offsets, broker API versions, and low-level log segment contents.

code.label: Quorum command dispatches describe/add-controller/remove-controller
Feature command dispatches describe/upgrade/downgrade/disable
DumpLogSegments dispatches by file suffix
GetOffsetShell fetches offsets at timestamp
ClusterTool dispatches cluster-id/unregister/list-endpoints/api-versions

group.note: Independent inspection tools, no ordering

anatomy.caption: Inspection tools and what they query
rows: KRaft quorum: leaders, followers, observers, lag
Feature flags: describe, upgrade, downgrade, disable
Cluster ID, broker/controller endpoints, API versions
Log directory sizes and replica placement
Raw log segments, indexes, transaction indexes
Trigger preferred or unclean leader elections

children.title: Metadata Shell
children.sub: Browse KRaft metadata snapshots interactively
children.detail: `MetadataShell` loads a KRaft snapshot file via `SnapshotFileReader` into a `MetadataImage`, then exposes it as a filesystem-like tree navigable with commands like `ls`, `cat`, `cd`, `find`, and `tree`.

code.label: Constructor, initializeWithSnapshotFileReader, and run
InteractiveShell jline reader loop with tab completion
TYPES registry: cat, cd, exit, find, help, history, ls, man, pwd, tree

anatomy.caption: How the metadata shell loads and serves a snapshot

issues.title: TreeCommandHandler inner class named CatCommandType
issues.detail: The inner type class in `TreeCommandHandler` is named `CatCommandType` instead of `TreeCommandType`, likely a copy-paste error. It works because `name()` returns "tree", but the class name is misleading.

issues.title: waitUntilCaughtUp spins without timeout
issues.detail: `MetadataShell.waitUntilCaughtUp` loops with 10ms sleeps checking `loader.lastAppliedOffset() > 0` but has no timeout. A corrupt or empty snapshot file will hang the shell forever.
